qa.question: Is the Big Sandy Peaker Plant in West Virginia, not Kentucky?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 55284 in Wayne County, West Virginia. The West Virginia air permit R30-09900080 from October 2024 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250307233856/https://dep.wv.gov/daq/permitting/titlevpermits/Documents/October%202024/099-00080/Final%20Pemit%20R30-09900080-2024.pdf) gives the facility location as Kenova, Wayne County, West Virginia. GEM shows the state as Kentucky.
qa.recommendation: Change State/Province to West Virginia for all six units in the web form. This moves the plant out of the Kentucky assignment.
qa.note: The permit address is a saved copy from the Wayback Machine because the live address returns an error. Coordinates 38.3441, -82.5938 sit at Kenova on the Ohio River, which fits West Virginia. I did not change Latitude or Longitude.

qa.question: Has Indiana Michigan Power bought the Big Sandy Peaker Plant from Middle River Power II?
qa.finding: The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission order of September 2, 2026 (https://secure.in.gov/iurc/files/ord_46301GRS1_090226.pdf) approves Indiana Michigan Power's request to buy the Big Sandy Peaker Plant in Kenova, West Virginia, for $299,525,000. The same order says closing still needs federal approvals from FERC and under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 already names Indiana Michigan Power Co, but I found no closing notice.
qa.recommendation: Leave Owner(s) as Middle River Power II LLC [100%] for now. Add the approved but not yet closed purchase to Notes and the possible-updates sheet, then look for a closing notice.
qa.note: An owner change needs a closed sale from two independent publishers. I found neither. The permit lists Big Sandy Peaker Plant, LLC as the permittee but I could not read its parent. The owner's own page and a 2025 or 2026 filing naming Middle River Power II as owner were not found in the budget I had. The order names the seller only as the seller, so Middle River Power II and Partners Group are not confirmed by it.

qa.question: Should the 59.0 MW capacity on each unit stay as it is?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) gives 58.9 MW nameplate for each of the six units. GEM shows 59.0 MW.
qa.recommendation: Leave as is. The difference is rounding and optional.
